summary: This note is a short wiki-style biography of Mark McCutcheon, an American former professional ice hockey player. It gives his birth date and birthplace and notes that he is the son of Brian McCutcheon, a former Buffalo Sabres associate coach and NHL player.
one_line: Biographical entry for Mark McCutcheon, an American former professional ice hockey player and son of NHL figure Brian McCutcheon.
key_facts: Mark McCutcheon was born on May 21, 1984.
Mark McCutcheon was born in Ithaca, New York.
Mark McCutcheon is an American former professional ice hockey player.
Mark McCutcheon is the son of Brian McCutcheon.
Brian McCutcheon is a former Buffalo Sabres Associate Coach.
Brian McCutcheon is a former NHL player.
